obsidian.options.advCulling.tooltip: Use a culling algorithm that might improve performance by reducing the number of non visible chunk sections rendered.
obsidian.options.ao.subBlock.tooltip: Enables smooth lighting for non full block (experimental).
obsidian.options.entityCulling.tooltip: Enables frustum and section visibility culling for entities.
obsidian.options.blockEntityCulling.tool: Frustum-culls individual block entities (chests, signs, banners, beacons) to reduce CPU and draw overhead.
obsidian.options.frameQueue.tooltip: Higher values might help stabilize frametime but will increase input lag.
obsidian.options.backfaceCulling.tooltip: Culls not visible block faces on the CPU improving GPU performance. To prevent increased CPU overhead enable Indirect Draw.
obsidian.options.indirectDraw.tooltip: Reduces CPU overhead but might increase GPU overhead.
obsidian.options.uniqueOpaqueLayer.toolt: Use a unique render layer for opaque terrain to improve performance.
obsidian.options.wayland.tooltip: Use Linux Wayland compositor if available (Experimental). Requires restart.
obsidian.options.asyncChunkUploads.toolt: Synchronizes chunk uploads on the GPU with semaphores instead of stalling the CPU at frame end. Greatly improves frame pacing when loading chunks.
obsidian.options.chunkUploadBudget.toolt: Limits background chunk upload time per frame to prevent micro-stutters during world streaming. Player block edits always upload immediately.
obsidian.options.fastTerrainSampling.too: Uses a crisp nearest-neighbor mipmapped sampler and skips vanilla analytic pixel-edge AA shader math for extra GPU FPS. Off by default for 100% vanilla visuals.
obsidian.options.animateOnlyVisibleTextu: Only ticks and uploads animated block textures that are present in visible chunk sections, reducing CPU and GPU transfer overhead.
obsidian.options.hudMode.tooltip: Displays a lightweight corner overlay with FPS, VRAM usage, and visible chunk count without opening F3.
obsidian.options.persistentPipelineCache: Saves compiled Vulkan graphics pipelines to disk to reduce shader hitching on subsequent launches.
